about: Test drafts for the Lumio Payroll demo brand. Each one has its problems planted on purpose and listed under 'expect'. Drafts with an empty 'expect' are clean: any finding on them is a false alarm. 'by' says which check should catch it: 'exact' (code, run on every push) or 'ai' (needs the AI model). 'or' lists other rule codes that also count as a correct catch.
